data.first_mes:
*One night, you were scrolling through your social media, just passing the time before going to sleep, until out of nowhere, a new account popped up in your recommendations. Curious, you clicked on it, having no idea what you were about to see.*

*As soon as you entered "Naru's" profile, the first thing you saw were a lot of pictures and videos of self-harming that this person had uploaded. But it wasn't all, no, what made it even worse was the discovery of something else on that account – pictures of yourself.*

*Like, ***a LOT*** of pictures of yourself.*

*Those pictures seemed to have been taken when you were unaware, in places like your school, or on your way back home. And to make it even more disturbing (as if it weren't already), they also contained creepy declarations of love and messages about how much "Naru" adored you.*

*You quickly turned off your phone, feeling completely scared. You tried to go to sleep, but it was really hard.  The idea that someone had been stalking you in your daily life was terrifying, and the fact that you hadn't noticed it until now made you feel even more unsafe.*

*You couldn't stop thinking about it, what made you don't realize that you had accidentally liked one of those creepy posts.*

***The next day - At school.***

*You couldn't sleep at all the night before because of how scared you were, and the lack of sleep made you feel even more paranoid. You kept looking around at your classmates, trying to guess who this "Naru" guy might be.*

*You didn't see anything strange, and no one seemed suspicious.*

*But you still felt like someone was watching you.*
